item.title: HiDream Launches Embodied Model for Robot Robustness
item.description: HiDream’s new world model unifies vision, video, 3D and actions, targeting robots that remain reliable under environmental disruption.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Sep 7
item.description: · Lovart published a reusable prompt for vertically splitting photographs into equal original-image and designed-poster halves.（Lovart） · Lovart showcased user-made artwork to position its generative design platform beyond producing conventional marketing assets.（Lovart） · Canva announced that its next AI Vision event will stream from London on September 15.（Canva） · Canva shared a creative-industry talk arguing that AI has made competent execution inexpensive, increasing pressure on creative differentiation.（Canva） · Tencent updated Hy4 Preview to reduce excessive reasoning and over-verification on complex tasks without sacrificing task quality.（Tencent Hunyuan） · Direct-drive robotics company Benmo showcased modular robots that transform within three seconds, with products reportedly sold across 50 countries.（量子位） · GOSIM Shenzhen published its 2026 agenda featuring more than 150 speakers from Nvidia, Microsoft, Hugging Face and other technology organizations.（量子位） · Recraft added a grainy folk-illustration option to its V4 style library, emphasizing bold characters and playful details.（Recraft） · A system combining a 4B Qwen model on phones with cloud-hosted GLM achieved a leading reported result on ARC-AGI 3.（量子位） · Dreamina selected ten weekly community-giveaway winners, each receiving 25,000 credits for its generative creative tools.（Dreamina） · A LobsterAI user report found 12.2% of model calls were unattended, while scheduled tasks averaged 64 calls per instruction.（量子位） · Meshy demonstrated Meshy 7 preserving the alignment of uploaded references while GPT-6 supplied higher-level reasoning.（Meshy） · Zhongke LeibraIn completed a several-hundred-million-yuan Series B+ round led by CRRC Capital for energy-aware AI infrastructure expansion.（量子位） · OpenAI, WAN-IFRA and AIRPPU launched AI training and implementation support for ten independent Ukrainian news organizations.（OpenAI）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Sep 6
item.description: · H Company released 260M- and 800M-parameter NeoMME encoders that process multilingual text and image patches through one bidirectional transformer.（MarkTechPost） · Authors challenged publishers and literary agents seeking shares of Anthropic’s copyright settlement, arguing the money belongs directly to affected writers.（TechCrunch） · Meta FAIR presented Research Preference Models that rank proposed machine-learning experiments before agents spend substantial GPU time executing them.（MarkTechPost） · GitHub introduced Canvases as persistent shared surfaces for tracking agent runs, code changes and items awaiting human review.（X / GitHub） · Travis Kalanick’s startup Atoms is reportedly considering entering the robotaxi market, extending its ambitions into autonomous transportation.（TechCrunch） · OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki argued that recursively self-improving AI will define frontier research and could eventually exceed human intelligence.（OpenAI） · Tripo previewed P2.0, a 3D-generation system intended to turn prompted environments into assets suitable for game-engine workflows.（X / Tripo） · Tripo demonstrated a prompted workflow combining GPT-6 Astra’s game logic with P2.0-generated environments inside Unity.（X / Tripo） · Databricks announced a Context Engineer Associate certification covering the skills required to curate context and build more capable AI agents.（X / Databricks） · Microsoft expanded Foundry’s model router to 28 regions and refreshed its pool of models available for automatic request routing.（InfoQ 中文） · Google Cloud said Gemini Enterprise subscriptions now place Antigravity under its standard security and compliance controls for organizational administrators.（X / Google Cloud Tech） · Psychiatrists are debating whether chatbot-reinforced delusions constitute a distinct “AI psychosis” condition or an amplification of existing disorders.（The Decoder） · Chinese startup Koko Matrix is pursuing embodied in-context learning, aiming to adapt robots to new tasks from demonstrations without conventional retraining.（量子位） · A novice creator reportedly built a Warcraft-inspired game prototype in 90 minutes using three prompts through the Astra-to-Tripo P2 pipeline.（X / Tripo）
